sections.text_helper: Section 16.12.11 "ADC watchdog threshold register (ADC_AWD3TR)" in chapter 16 (Analog-to-digital converter (ADC)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 340.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x2C
Reset value: 0x0FFF 0000
Bits 31:28 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 27:16 HT3[11:0]: Analog watchdog 3 higher threshold
These bits are written by software to define the higher threshold for the analog watchdog.
Refer to Section 16.8: Analog window watchdogs on page 315.
Bits 15:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:0 LT3[11:0]: Analog watchdog 3lower threshold
These bits are written by software to define the lower threshold for the analog watchdog.
Refer to Section 16.8: Analog window watchdogs on page 315.
